svg.text: Internationalization (i18n) System — LLD
Translation Architecture & Loading
Message catalog: JSON per locale {key: "translated string"} or ICU format
Namespace splitting: split by route/feature — load only what's needed per page
Dynamic loading: import(`./locales/${locale}/common.json`) on locale switch
Fallback chain: requested locale → base language → default locale
Missing key strategy: return key itself as fallback; log to monitoring
SSR: pass locale + translations as server props; avoid client refetch
CDN caching: translation files cached at edge; bust on deploy (content hash)
Over-the-air updates: fetch translations independently of app deploy
Pluralization, Formatting & ICU
Plural rules: CLDR defines 6 categories (zero/one/two/few/many/other)
ICU MessageFormat: "{count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}}"
Variables in strings: "Hello, {name}" — never concatenate strings
Date formatting: Intl.DateTimeFormat(locale, options) — no moment.js
Number formatting: Intl.NumberFormat for currencies, percentages, units
Relative time: Intl.RelativeTimeFormat("2 hours ago") — locale-aware
List formatting: Intl.ListFormat("a, b, and c") — conjunction/disjunction
Rich text: Trans component renders HTML tags within translated strings safely
RTL, Layout & Text Direction
RTL locales: Arabic, Hebrew, Persian, Urdu — dir="rtl" on html element
CSS logical properties: margin-inline-start vs margin-left — RTL-safe
Flexbox direction: row-reverse not needed if using logical properties
Icons: mirror directional icons (arrows, back) for RTL; non-directional stay
Text expansion: German/Finnish 30-40% longer than English — leave room
CJK: Chinese/Japanese/Korean — no word-wrap spaces; overflow: break-word
Font loading: load locale-specific subsets (CJK subsets 2MB+ without subsetting)
Testing: Playwright with RTL viewport; screenshot diff for layout regression
Locale Detection, Routing & Workflow
Detection priority: user preference → Accept-Language header → geo IP → default
URL strategy: /en/page, /de/page — SEO-friendly; Next.js i18n routing
Cookie persistence: save locale choice in cookie; respect on return visit
hreflang: link rel=alternate hreflang="de" href="/de/page" in head
Translation workflow: source strings extracted → sent to TMS (Phrase/Lokalise)
Pseudo-localization: replace chars with accented equivalents to catch hardcoded strings
Key extraction: i18next-parser / formatjs extract CLI in CI pipeline
Translation coverage check: fail build if new source strings have no translation
Namespace splitting: load only page translations
ICU MessageFormat for plurals and variables
CSS logical properties: RTL-safe without overrides
URL routing: /en/page for SEO + hreflang tags
Pseudo-loc in CI catches hardcoded strings early
